# Extra Alpine packages preinstalled in the dsh-go iSH rootfs.
#
# Format: one package per line, `name` or pinned `name=version`.
# Pinned versions are verified against the live APKINDEX at build time:
# if a pinned version is gone from the repo, the build fails loudly
# (update the pin). Dependencies are resolved from the live index and
# recorded in rootfs-packages.lock.
#
# Versions below were pinned 2026-11-17 against the live Alpine 3.21
# aarch64 APKINDEX (main repo; all 18 packages are in main).
#
# What ships (and why):
#   bash       — the sandbox shell (the DSH "bash" tool runs /bin/bash;
#                the base image only has busybox ash)
#   python3    — Python 3.12, the scripting runtime
#   py3-pip    — pip, so the agent can install Python packages
#   ripgrep    — `rg`, required by the DSH agent's file search (glob/grep)
#   curl       — standard HTTP client (base image only has busybox wget)
#   nodejs     — Node.js 22 (the DSH engine runtime; also what `node` is)
#   npm        — npm 10 (ships separately from nodejs in Alpine)
#   pnpm       — pnpm 9, fast disk-efficient package manager
#   git        — git, version control
#   coreutils  — GNU coreutils (ENV-06): replaces the BusyBox applets at
#                /bin/* and /usr/bin/* in place, so `ls`, `cat`, `sort`,
#                `date` etc. accept GNU options. The installer overwrites
#                the busybox symlinks (takeover); see
#                install-rootfs-packages.py.
#   findutils  — GNU find/xargs (ENV-06): `find -printf` etc.
#   grep       — GNU grep (ENV-06): `grep -P`, `grep --color` etc.
#   procps-ng  — ps/top/pgrep (ENV-06): `ps -p`, `ps -o ...` etc.
#                NOTE: the Alpine package is named `procps-ng`, there is
#                no `procps` package in Alpine 3.21.
#   sed        — GNU sed 4.9 (ENV-06): `sed --version` works. NOTE: GNU sed
#                DOES exist as an apk in Alpine 3.21 main (earlier notes
#                said it did not — that was wrong); it replaces the
#                BusyBox sed applet at /bin/sed in place.
#   jq         — JSON processor (ENV-11)
#   make       — GNU make (ENV-11)
#   build-base — compiler toolchain meta-package (ENV-11): pulls in gcc,
#                g++, binutils, musl-dev, libc-dev, file, patch. This is
#                the big one — gcc alone is ~123 MiB installed, the whole
#                toolchain closure ~230 MiB installed (see the verification
#                report for exact numbers). It was deliberately excluded
#                before to keep the image small; it is included now because
#                the user ordered all env issues fixed (native builds and
#                node-gyp need it).
#   util-linux-misc — `script` and friends (ENV-02): lets the agent use
#                `script -qec` to get a pty as a fallback. NOTE: install
#                the `util-linux-misc` subpackage, NOT the `util-linux`
#                meta-package — the meta-package itself is 1 byte with no
#                dependencies and installs nothing; `script` lives in
#                -misc (plus libblkid/libmount/libfdisk/libsmartcols deps).
#
# Deliberately NOT included (install on demand with `apk add`):
#   bun — NOT available as an apk in Alpine 3.21 (no `bun` package in
#   main or community); install it separately if needed (official
#   aarch64 binary from bun.sh, or `npm i -g bun` once npm is present).
bash=5.2.37-r0
python3=3.12.16-r0
py3-pip=24.3.1-r0
ripgrep=14.1.1-r0
curl=8.14.1-r3
nodejs=22.23.5-r0
npm=10.9.1-r0
pnpm=9.15.9-r0
git=2.47.3-r0
coreutils=9.5-r2
findutils=4.10.0-r0
grep=3.11-r0
procps-ng=4.0.4-r2
sed=4.9-r2
jq=1.8.2-r0
make=4.4.1-r2
build-base=0.5-r3
util-linux-misc=2.40.4-r1
